text:
taylor-cs: FYI — Lighthouse Health has a pilot tomorrow at 15:00 UTC. During internal smoke test they saturated our eu-west edge and saw p95 ~450ms. They asked for a temporary regional allowlist + short uplift for eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1. Renewal review in 14 days; customer execs watched the last demo.
marc-ops: Thanks. Can you share CIDRs + expected qps and any vendor partners?
taylor-cs: Customer IPs: `198.51.100.77/32`, partner (analytics) `198.51.101.0/24`. Expect burst up to 900 qps for ~25m, steady ~150 qps. They also asked to route partner traffic via eu-west-1 to keep telemetry local.
anya-net: Proposed plan: create allowlist rule AL-LH-030 and a TEMP_RATE_12H policy with max_qps 1200, burst allowance 30m, TTL 12h auto-revoke. Pin routing to eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1. Will warm KV cache prefixes after deploy. Need sec approval for partner CIDR and vendor handshake.
drew-sec: Security: require documented AUP and vendor TLS cert rotation. Partner must accept minimal retention policy for logs. 12h TTL ok, approve conditioned on ticket attachment CS-11345.
sophia-ae: I'll prep the exec note and mark renewal watch. Recommend a 15m runbook call with their infra lead 1 hour before demo.
marc-ops: Plan to run the following. If no objections I'll schedule at 14:30 UTC to allow warm-up.
```
POST /admin/allowlists
{"name":"AL-LH-030","cidrs":["198.51.100.77/32","198.51.101.0/24"],"ttl":"12h","auto_revoke":true}
POST /policies/rate
{"name":"TEMP_RATE_12H","max_qps":"1200","burst_window_sec":"1800","regions":["eu-west-1","ap-southeast-1"]}
```
anya-net: LGTM. After apply I'll run `kv-warm --prefix lighthouse:session` and pre-populate common embeddings cache.
drew-sec: I'll sign off in ticket CS-11345 once AUP uploaded. Also request partner to enable mTLS within 24h for future persistent rules.
ops-bot: allowlist AL-LH-030 scheduled at 2026-05-02T14:30:00Z by marc-ops
taylor-cs: Deployed and pinned routing. Initial spike hit ~820 qps, p95 dropped from 460ms -> 78ms in eu-west. ap-southeast improved to ~130ms p95 after cache warm.
sophia-ae: Demo completed — execs reported smoother experience. I'll downgrade renewal risk from red -> yellow and send the feedback pulse.
marc-ops: Customer asked for a 4h ephemeral add for a contractor CIDR `198.51.102.0/24` to run additional analytics. Security sign-off?
drew-sec: OK for 4h ephemeral with manual approval and audit. Require contractor to rotate creds and use scoped token. I'll add sign-off to CS-11345.
marc-ops: Added contractor CIDR with TTL 4h, auto-revoke set. Rule AL-LH-030 updated. Monitoring shows stable connections.
taylor-cs: Thanks team — I'll log NPS + latency stats and schedule a 7-day follow-up. Great work!
